narrative.overview: The captured new-generation Clover surface finished site-wide: one green family in flat color blocks, condensed-black display over a Graphik workhorse, real-merchant video preserved with production hygiene, and the audit's thirteen findings closed without moving a single content beat.
keyCharacteristics: single green family, no second hue
flat — separation is a ground change

rules.name: The One-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every non-neutral surface is a green; a second hue is a defect.

rules.name: The Lime Ration
rules.body: One lime block and/or CTA pair per viewport; lime never carries body text.

rules.name: The Major-Third Rule
rules.body: Text steps at 1.25 (16/20/25/31); 56 and 92 are display-only jumps. Replaces the captured ad-hoc scale.

rules.name: The Case Split
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to Formula Condensed headline roles and short imperative labels only.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Inherited: separation is a background change, never elevation.

rules.name: The Poster Rule
rules.body: Text over video always sits on an opaque luminance-matched poster + scrim >=4.5:1, in every state including prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Big-Image Rule
rules.body: Images with natural width >600px never render below 600px on desktop — an explicit Clover trait (user-pinned 2026-07-26).

rules.name: The Edge-Bleed Rule
rules.body: Large section media has no border with the window: it bleeds to the viewport edge (square outer corners); copy stays on the 1158px container grid (user-pinned 2026-07-26).
